# retrievium

> A Go library providing 5 searching algorithm implementations behind a single `Searcher` interface. One interface. No haystack required.

retrievium is importable as `github.com/danielriddell21/retrievium`. It has no external dependencies.

The central interface:

```go
type Searcher[E cmp.Ordered] interface {
    Search(haystack []E, target E) (int, bool) // index of target and whether it was found
    Name() string                              // human-readable algorithm name
}
```

BinarySearcher, TernarySearcher, FibonacciSearcher, and JumpSearcher require the input slice to be sorted in ascending order. LinearSearcher works on any input.

## Algorithms

| Searcher | Time | Space | Requires sorted input |
|---|---|---|---|
| LinearSearcher | O(n) | O(1) | No |
| BinarySearcher | O(log n) | O(1) | Yes |
| TernarySearcher | O(log₃ n) | O(1) | Yes |
| FibonacciSearcher | O(log n) | O(1) | Yes |
| JumpSearcher | O(√n) | O(1) | Yes |
